enabled_scope: engineering repair and offline replay only
shared_verifier: typed percentage units, frozen question/gold hash binding
PRM_view: CRLF->LF copy, native double-LF step boundaries, raw CoT preserved

extra_objective.status: proposal and offline diagnostic only; not enabled

arms.A: outcome-only GRPO with common repaired verifier
arms.C: same PRM initialization; L_fail+L_success+L_step adaptation then freeze
arms.D: same as C except success weak supervision coefficient c=0

controls: same actor starting checkpoint, data, generated-token budget, seeds and optimizer across arms
same PRM initialization and native input rule across B/C/D
same adaptation batches, anchors, optimizer and number of updates across C/D
old H4 C/D adapters are not an adaptation control for Qwen7B B
old-rule A/B results stay historical; rescoring cannot undo their training gradients
data_selection: no quarantine, no partner filtering, no new data selection
source_protection: 331 frozen original input file hashes verified before and after
